<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600;700&family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>

/* ===============================
   GLOBAL STYLING
=================================*/

body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  background: #fdf8f5;
  color: #2c2c2c;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

h1, h2 {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  margin: 0;
}

/* ===============================
   HERO SECTION
=================================*/

.hero {
  height: 100vh;
  background: linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.4), rgba(0,0,0,0.4)),
              url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1519741497674-611481863552") center/cover no-repeat;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  color: white;
}

.hero-content {
  animation: fadeIn 2s ease forwards;
  opacity: 0;
}

.hero h1 {
  font-size: 4rem;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}

.hero p {
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
}

/* ===============================
   OUR STORY SECTION
=================================*/

.story-section {
  padding: 100px 15%;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
}

.story-section h2 {
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  color: #b76e79;
}

/* Timeline animation */

.timeline {
  position: relative;
  margin-top: 50px;
}

.timeline::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  width: 3px;
  background: #b76e79;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.timeline-item {
  width: 50%;
  padding: 20px 40px;
  position: relative;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(40px);
  transition: all 1s ease;
}

.timeline-item.left {
  left: 0;
  text-align: right;
}

.timeline-item.right {
  left: 50%;
}

.timeline-item.show {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.timeline-item::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  background: #b76e79;
  border-radius: 50%;
  top: 30px;
  right: -9px;
}

.timeline-item.right::after {
  left: -9px;
}

/* ===============================
   FOOTER
=================================*/

footer {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 40px;
  background: #b76e79;
  color: white;
}

/* ===============================
   ANIMATIONS
=================================*/

@keyframes fadeIn {
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

@media(max-width: 900px) {
  .timeline::before {
    left: 20px;
  }

  .timeline-item {
    width: 100%;
    padding-left: 60px;
    padding-right: 20px;
    text-align: left !important;
  }

  .timeline-item.right {
    left: 0;
  }

  .timeline-item::after {
    left: 11px !important;
  }
}

</style>

<!-- ===============================
     HERO
================================= -->

<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-content">
    <h1>Emma & James</h1>
    <p>Our Story Begins</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===============================
     OUR STORY
================================= -->

<section class="story-section">

  <h2>Our Story</h2>

  <div class="timeline">

    <div class="timeline-item left">
      <h3>2018 — First Meeting</h3>
      <p>
        What started as a casual conversation turned into hours of laughter.
        Neither of us knew that this moment would change everything.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="timeline-item right">
      <h3>2020 — Falling in Love</h3>
      <p>
        Through adventures, travels, and quiet nights,
        we discovered that love feels like home.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="timeline-item left">
      <h3>2024 — The Proposal</h3>
      <p>
        Under a golden sunset, with hearts racing,
        we said yes to forever.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="timeline-item right">
      <h3>2026 — Our Wedding</h3>
      <p>
        Now we begin our greatest adventure —
        surrounded by the people we love most.
      </p>
    </div>

  </div>

</section>

<footer>
  With love, Emma & James 💕
</footer>

<script>

// Scroll animation reveal
const items = document.querySelectorAll(".timeline-item");

function revealOnScroll() {
  const triggerBottom = window.innerHeight * 0.85;

  items.forEach(item => {
    const boxTop = item.getBoundingClientRect().top;

    if(boxTop < triggerBottom) {
      item.classList.add("show");
    }
  });
}

window.addEventListener("scroll", revealOnScroll);
revealOnScroll();

</script>
